registration.purpose: One fixed public scheme/pace/rest/lagged-coaching/historical-venue feature group incremental to frozen base97; descriptive exposed development only
registration.baseline: Reuse unchanged initial campaign 2023 ridge rows; no baseline refit
registration.challenger: Shared models.fit_predict ridge, existing alpha32/logistic settings unchanged; one new fit per target and no hyperparameter selection

feature_definitions.scrimmage: Source play_type pass/run, qb_kneel=0 and qb_spike=0; missing flags do not become zero
feature_definitions.neutral: Earlier-game competitive scrimmage plays, quarters1-3, downs1-2, abs(pre-play score_differential)<=7, half_seconds_remaining>120; historical state only
feature_definitions.rates: Pool supported numerators/denominators over exact last3 eligible team games; report known supporting-game count; no search for older nonmissing games
feature_definitions.clock_runoff_seconds: Mean positive<=60 game-clock-second decrement between adjacent source plays that are both competitive scrimmage, same possession/drive/quarter; a public tempo proxy, not measured snap timing
feature_definitions.opponent_adjustment: Each prior game's neutral-dropback-rate and scrimmage-play count minus the earlier opponent's own exact-last3 eligible defense/offense rates or means before that prior game's kickoff; no target realised mix
feature_definitions.roles: Team offensive style plus target opponent defensive exposures; separate prior-only windows
feature_definitions.rest: Days since most recent strictly prior scheduled kickoff, derived from schedule identities/dates without outcomes; original historical schedule publication unauthenticated
feature_definitions.coach: Did the two most recent eligible historical games list different coaches; lagged indicator, not a claim of target-game coaching plans
feature_definitions.venue: Target scheduled stadium identity only; prior same-stadium closed/dome-roof and artificial-surface rates from earlier games eligible by kickoff+7d; no target realised roof, surface or weather

acquisition.2022: One public nflverse PBP asset SHA 931121d8897779d7944e2a293e92ed8799c8e5cceef84096ac42339003fedc09; 20426548 bytes

registration.availability: All outcome-derived PBP/coach/venue inputs strictly before cutoff under reconstructed kickoff+7d availability; no original historical publication claim. Exact last3 roster/schedule game slots include missing PBP and stale slots.
registration.future_evaluation: No 2024/2025/2026 outcome evaluation; read base cache only through2023; already exposed2023 development only
registration.promotion: disabled; no automatic activation or transfer of improvement claims
source_limits: No complete authenticated historical injury/news snapshots
No public route counts in this PBP schema
Historical coach/roof fields are retrospective game metadata, used only with declared lag
registration.publication: Code/config/manifests/reviewed aggregates only; raw and row files remain ignored

source_inputs.rights: nflverse public source credit; upstream NFL/other rights separate; lab publishes no raw or player-game source rows

source_inputs.availability: kickoff+7days reconstruction; original historical publication and revisions unauthenticated

feature_manifest.availability: reconstructed kickoff+7d; strict earlier cutoff; exact3 game slots; maxage60days
feature_manifest.roof_surface: earlier same-venue observations only; not a forecast of target roof/weather
feature_manifest.coach: lagged observed change only; no target coach plan
feature_manifest.rest: strictly prior schedule kickoff dates only
